text:
maya: heads up — planning a small 'wavelet' deploy at 18:00 PT to push a router header swap and runtime patch. need quick sync across api, runtime, console, router. no major schema changes.
julian: thanks. what exactly is pinned? which images/variants?
maya: runtime -> rtf-v2.3.1 (pin), api -> api-v2.3.1 (pin), router -> header-swap-2026 (config flip), console -> no code change, just watch dashboards.
sam: can we canary 5% for 10m then ramp if no errors? deploybot can do a wavelet if we ask.
maya: yes 5% then 30% then full over 30m. primary risk is KV eviction pressure during header swap — lee is looking.
lee: looked at kv metrics: memory pressure ok at 5% but if we misroute, hotkeys could spike. recommend setting eviction threshold 0.85 and short-lived backoff.
zara: I'll add dashboards: latency, 95/99 p99.9, error-rate, kv-evict-rate, token-per-request. also add a synthetic through the router header path.
julian: rollback criteria? what triggers immediate rollback vs pause?
sam: propose immediate rollback if p99 latency +50% OR error-rate > 1% sustained 2m, OR kv-evict-rate > baseline * 3. otherwise pause and triage.
maya: agreed. also manual rollback if Console shows customer-facing errors in > 3 distinct regions.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wavelet starting 1764446400 (2026-10-02 18:00 PT). Planned steps:
1) pin runtime rtf-v2.3.1 on dedicated pool
2) deploy api-v2.3.1 to 5% (canary)
3) apply router header-swap-2026 to 5%
4) monitor 10m, ramp 30% -> 100%
Commands: /deploy wavelet --pins rtf-v2.3.1,api-v2.3.1 --canary 5 --steps 5m,5m,20m
julian: can deploybot give me the exact variant ids? I want to pre-check compat matrix.
maya: variant ids: rtf-v2.3.1@sha256:aa11bb, api-v2.3.1@sha256:cc22dd, router-header@cfg:swap-2026-1
sam: thanks — I'll run a quick local smoke against api-v2.3.1 and the header path.
lee: ops note: set kv eviction threshold via opsbot before canary: /opsbot set-kv-threshold 0.85 --scope wavelet-1764443210
opsbot: opsbot: kv-threshold set to 0.85 for wavelet-1764443210. Notifying infra team.
zara: added dashboards and synthetic check. alerting: slack #incidents if p99 > 1.5s or error-rate > 0.5% for 2m.
maya: release notes snippet (for internal): "Wavelet 1764443210 — runtime and api patch, router header swap for feature gating. Canary 5% -> gradual ramp. Rollback triggers: latency, errors, kv-eviction spike."
julian: doc the postmortem owner and rollback owner? who will own rollback button if we need it?
maya: rollback owner: sam. postmortem owner: julian. Communications: ops oncall + eng-releases channel.
sam: I'll be oncall 18:00-19:00 PT and hit rollback if thresholds exceeded. :thumbsup:
maya: final check: any objections or missing calls?
julian: none from infra side. confirmed variants.
lee: no objections. KV threshold set.
zara: alerting wired.
maya: ok locking plan. tagging @deploybot to run at scheduled time. thanks everyone :eyes:
deploybot: deploybot: acknowledged. wavelet scheduled. will post updates in-thread during rollout.
